title: Non-test Node commands (a freeze script) are recognised as test checks, then reported as uncredited "no passing test"
outcome: Non-test Node commands (a freeze script) are recognised as test checks, then reported as uncredited "no passing test"
acceptance: A Node command that runs no test runner (for example a freeze or fingerprint script that prints a SHA) is not recorded as a test check and produces no 'recognised test gets no credit' line; a test covers that case and the existing recognised forms (npx vitest, cargo test, node scripts/test-launcher.mjs) still record as before.
The host line for an uncredited recognised test names the command it refers to, or this item records why w-57d917e06cba already covers that.
